page.overview:
Who is Fiona Thorne?

Fiona Thorne was the mother of Aric Thorne.

Fiona Thorne's son Aric was a member of Gurney's Own, an elite strike force that served House Atreides in the War of Assassins. He sent recordings to her in which he spoke of his drive to remain determined despite the visciousness of House Harkonnen. The Atreides had several victories, but many their soldiers died, including Aric's friends. Gurney's Own were deployed to weaken Harkonnen resources on the Easten Shield Wall, with Aric telling his mother that despite their triumphs, he was losing his resolve due to the bloodshed and seeing his own comrades commit despicable acts. Aric was declared missing in action later that month, leaving the devastated Fiona to question the necessity of the conflict.

Redondo Monroe played recordings of Aric's messages and Fiona's diaries on an episode of Through Their Eyes: Firsthand Accounts from the Frontlines, though much of the recordings of Fiona were heavily edited due to her critical comments about the war.
